Name: Finnair
Company description: Founded in 1923, Finnair is one of the world’s oldest operating airlines. We are a network airline specialised in connecting Europe, North America and Asia via our transfer-friendly Helsinki hub – our purpose is to enrich life by bridging the world. Sustainability is at the core of our strategy. Our long-term target is carbon neutrality: we want to maintain the social and economic benefits enabled by air connections, while dramatically reducing the carbon footprint of air travel. For more information on Finnair, please refer to www.company.finnair.com or www.finnair.com.

Name: Nordic Regional Airlines Oy N°RRA
Company description: Nordic Regional Airlines, also known as NORRA, is a Finnish airline. The company’s core mission is to provide safe, high-quality regional flight operations for other airlines, agilely, ecologically and cost-effectively. NORRA is a preferred partner of Finnair and operates a significant part of Finnair’s domestic and European traffic. The company operates over 50 000 flights yearly. The company's modern and young fleet consists of 24 aircraft and the airline employs around 600 people in Finland. Norra's headquarters and operations centre are located in Helsinki-Vantaa and financial administration in Seinäjoki.  The company was originally founded in 1993 and has previously served as Finnish Commuter Airlines and Flybe Finland. For more information or to contact us, please go to www.flynorra.com.

Name: FinnHEMS Oy
Company description: Jokaisella suomalaisella on oikeus ensiluokkaiseen ensihoitoon. Lääkäri- ja lääkintähelikopteritoiminta on suomalaisen ensihoitopalvelun keihäänkärki ja tärkeä osa yhteiskunnan kokonaisturvallisuutta. Hätäkeskuslaitoksen välittämistä tehtävistä suurin osa, vuosittain noin 730 000 tehtävää, osoitetaan terveydenhuollon hoidettavaksi. Näistä noin 14 000 kriittisintä ohjataan FinnHEMSin yksiköille.  Lääkäri- ja lääkintähelikopterin tärkein tehtävä on tuoda tehohoitotasoinen ensihoito mahdollisimman nopeasti potilaan luo. Näin jo tapahtumapaikalla voidaan aloittaa hoito, joka muuten alkaisi vasta sairaalassa. HEMS-toiminta mahdollistaa yhden päivystyspisteen palveluiden ulottamisen laajalle alueelle, jolloin ihmiset ovat yhdenvertaisempia ensihoitopalvelun saajina. Valtakunnallinen HEMS-toiminta parantaa palvelun tasalaatuisuutta ja edistää  ensihoidon laatua valtakunnallisesti.  Brief in English Every citizen is entitled to the best possible emergency care. HEMS services are the spearhead of Finnish emergency care services and play a vital role in maintaining the safety of the society. Yearly, FinnHEMS’ units receive approximately 14 000 assignments.   The mission of HEMS-operations is to transport top-of-the-art emergency care to the patient as fast as possible. Hence, the patient receives care at the scene of emergency, which would otherwise not begin before reaching the hospital. HEMS enable one unit to serve large areas, which again improves the equality of inhabitants in receiving emergency care.
